newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila buys 200,000 tonnes rice from Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Manila buys 200,000 tonnes rice from Vietnam.

text.p: The Philippines clinched a deal for up to 200,000 tonnes of rice from Vietnam, a senior official from the Agriculture Department said on Monday.

"The contract for 100,000 tonnes of Vietnamese white rice was signed by the National Food Authority on Saturday. The contract also gave NFA the option to buy another 100,000 tonnes," the official who requested not to be named told Reuters.
"The Vietnamese rice was priced $8 lower than the Thai rice bought earlier by the NFA," the Agriculture official said.
Thai traders told Reuters in Bangkok early this month the Philippines bought 205,000 tonnes of Thai rice at $300 per tonne.
Last week, President Fidel Ramos approved the import of up to 650,000 tonnes of rice to beef up the country's buffer stocks before July this year.
Philippine rice output in the third quarter has traditionally been low.
